overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the UCLA Bruins women's basketball team on winning the 2026 NCAA Division I national championship, beating South Carolina 79-51 in Phoenix, Arizona. It notes that this was the program's first NCAA women's basketball title, that the team finished 37-1 under its head coach, and that its six seniors scored every point in the final. It asks that copies be sent to UCLA's chancellor, head coach and athletic director. It is ceremonial and does not change any law. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on April 30, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is fitting for the Senate to honor a team's historic championship season and the athletes and coaches behind it.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
